facts.premium: Around the southern norm; a solid rubber-and-palm economy with a meaningful processing base.
facts.skill_gap: Farm-skewed, but a relatively large processing workforce (~24k factory workers) for its size.
anchors: Rubber — one of the South's core rubber provinces
Rubber and palm processing (~24k factory workers)
impacts: Trang is rubber heartland; tapper income and repayment track the rubber market.
Secondary palm income pressured by falling FFB prices.
~24k factory workers add a formal-income buffer rare for a province this size.
63% motorcycles support broad small-ticket title lending.
~83% informal — strong demand, cash-flow-based underwriting needed.
Heavy Andaman-side rain interrupts tapping and harvest income.
